owner_rule.disposition_rule: Compare real task function, evidence completeness, scope, cost, reliability and risk; retire only with evidence that all valuable uses are covered, preserve uncertainty when comparisons are insufficient.

task_context.task: Bind one caller-supplied completed tool run to an observation by exact tool/version/source/input/output/environment/run identifiers, retain failed-run evidence, and optionally reread bounded local Ignition file state.
task_context.same_task_comparison: The exact receipt_input recorded from the local PR #264 target-coverage replay was evaluated by this candidate and checked against the portable episode, Actions attribution and failure-recovery contracts. Existing tools rejected or invalidated that object under their distinct contracts; the source-snapshot verifier was not invoked because its input is a captured E37 run directory.

comparators.useful_scope: Versioned research artifacts, run references, reviews, omissions and fork mappings.
comparators.gap_for_this_task: An EXECUTED entry requires a generic run_ref but this tool does not bind tool version, source/input/output digests, environment, later observation chronology, or current local file state.

comparators.useful_scope: GitHub Actions validation plans, workflow runs, artifact inventories and optional target receipts.
comparators.gap_for_this_task: Its specific plan, run, artifact and component-validation receipt contract is not a general local or non-GitHub tool invocation observer.

comparators.useful_scope: Preserved failed-run evidence, diagnosis references and a bounded proposed recovery or retry.
comparators.gap_for_this_task: It gates a failure recovery proposal; it does not produce a general post-run observation of current repository file state.

comparators.useful_scope: A specific captured offline source snapshot artifact set.
comparators.gap_for_this_task: It checks its declared snapshot artifact contract and is not a general tool/version/environment/run outcome binder.

unique_remaining_use_cases: Bind a generic completed tool run and later caller observation across exact identity, source/input/output digest, environment, run ID and chronology.
Independently reread a caller-selected, bounded regular file under ignition/ and compare its current SHA-256 with a caller-declared baseline without returning file contents.
findings: The existing validators have useful adjacent scopes and are retained for those tasks.
The candidate provides a separate generic outcome-reference and bounded local file-state observation contract; it does not replace an existing validator.
The local reread observes current checkout bytes but cannot authenticate its caller-supplied baseline, identify which action caused a difference, or establish a scientific conclusion.
No matched quality, reliability, latency, operator-time, or monetary-cost comparison was conducted; those dimensions remain UNKNOWN.
comparison_result.disposition: Coexist for the generic tool-run receipt and bounded current checkout observation use case. Reassess if an existing or future tool proves full valuable-use coverage under comparable permissions, environment and evidence quality.

claim_ceiling: This is a bounded functional-scope comparison and low-cost contract exercise. It does not prove comparative performance, cost, broad reliability, scientific validity, or a replacement decision beyond the declared scope.
